bugClass.title: Port omits a required style class
bugClass.cause: A UI port preserves one class from a composed class list but drops another class that supplies essential visual properties, leaving a partial or browser-default appearance.
bugClass.criteria: Classify when a rendered component or template omits a source/mockup class that is required alongside a retained class for the intended styling. This includes omitted classes that supply border width or color when a retained class sets only border style. Consider each missing-class styling dependency independently.

candidates.evidence: Line 53 shows `.hh-home .hh-empty` sets flex layout, spacing, dashed border style, and line height, but the excerpt lacks the base `.po-empty` border width/color rules and rendered class usage; the missing-class dependency is not established.
Lines 110–117 show the rendered empty state receives `po-empty hh-empty`, so this site retains both candidate classes. The evidence does not establish a dropped class.
Lines 88–90 show the mockup emits both `po-empty` and `hh-empty`, but no styling rules or rendered port counterpart are provided here, so a dropped required class cannot be established.
